'''[[Grievous, Hunter Of Jedi]]''' was published in [[Virtual Block 7]]. Its release-sheet and master-list versions are shown below.

== Release-sheet version ==
[[File:VL-history-1271-1-front-original.png|180px|Release-sheet version front face]]

=== Cyborg Commander, Hunter Of Jedi (front) ===
{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Printed value
|-
| Title || Cyborg Commander, Hunter Of Jedi
|-
| Uniqueness || 1
|-
| Lore || Leader. “He’s no Jedi.”
|-
| Destiny || 1
|-
| Power || 7
|-
| Ability || 5
|-
| Deploy || 6
|-
| Forfeit || 8

{{anchor|original-front-text}}
[Virtual Block 5] Dark Jedi Lightsaber may deploy on Cyborg Commander. Jedi present are power -1 (-2 if a Jedi Council Member). While armed with a lightsaber, your battle destiny draws here are +1 and his forfeit may not be reduced. Immune to attrition &lt; 4.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Players Committee virtual-card sheet], PDF page 2. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

== Name change ==
The [[Players Committee]] announced the persona-name change on 29 January 2013, effective immediately; existing slips remained tournament-valid.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], Players Committee, 29 January 2013. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].</ref>
